Content-Length browser stream exposes immediate global receiving feedback without switching tab
known-length upload displays a bounded nonfinal percentage

landscape retains the entire global receive status without tab change

receiving progress remains global on 共享 tab
receiving progress remains global on 连接 tab
receiving progress remains global on 文字 tab
receiving progress remains global on 记录 tab

browser stream finishes as one unchanged temporary file for independent client C
server completion says received rather than saved
layout fixture completes without changing the temporary-storage contract
completed feedback expires without becoming a persistent old receive event
chunked Shortcuts protocol shows received bytes with an indeterminate progress node
paused sender becomes waiting for data without a false failure or completion
new bytes return waiting feedback to receiving on the current tab
chunked Shortcuts protocol finishes unchanged without automatic Downloads
native chunk protocol shows committed byte and percentage progress globally
